emulator.note: The emulator runs on loopback in the same container as the test client. Its data backend is memory, so this proves protocol behaviour, not media durability.

auth.note: Service-account RS256 signing is verified offline against the published RFC 7515 A.2 vector and the OAuth2 exchange/cache against an in-process endpoint. A status of no_credentials means no live exchange was attempted: no service-account key exists in this environment, so this receipt makes no live-GCS authentication claim. Set WEFT_GCS_SA_KEY to a key file to run the live probe.

fencing.shared_bodies: tests/support/fencing.rs (also run by scripts/s3_court.sh on MinIO and scripts/ceph_court.sh on Ceph RGW)
fencing.note: Generation-precondition fencing: takeover, fence-before-head, renewal, own-deadline stop, and a conditional tombstone release.

label: Single-host GCS-compatible emulator on loopback in the OOM-protected Docker court with a memory backend. Not a cloud, multi-node, fleet, device-cache, media, power-loss, or production claim.
